title: Points of Judgement on Revisions Beyond the Allowance When a Change Is Agreed
content:
# Points of Judgement on Revisions Beyond the Allowance When a Change Is Agreed

Where a change to the specification is agreed on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions, what each revision beyond the allowance included in the quoted total is charged at turns on two things read from the commission itself: how many design revisions have already been drawn on it, and whether the piece has gone into production.

## The rule

1. Where every design revision included in the quoted total has already been drawn and the piece has gone into production, each revision beyond the included allowance is charged at 2 times the programme's published charge for an additional revision.
2. Where every design revision included in the quoted total has already been drawn and the piece has not gone into production, each is charged at 1 times that charge.
3. Otherwise nothing is charged for the revisions the change calls for.

## The two readings

| Reading | Taken from |
|---|---|
| Have all the included revisions been drawn? | The count of design revisions drawn on the commission over its whole life, set against the number the programme includes in the quoted total; all are drawn once that count stands at or above the included number |
| Has the piece gone into production? | The date production began, as it stands on the commission; the piece has gone into production where that date stands, and has not where it is empty |

## The programme figures the rule turns on

| Programme | Design revisions included in the quoted total | Published charge for an additional revision |
|---|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | 1 | USD 125.00 |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | 2 | USD 175.00 |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | 3 | USD 250.00 |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | 4 | USD 350.00 |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | 3 | USD 275.00 |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | 6 | USD 600.00 |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- A Design Studio Custom Setting commission includes 2 revisions, 2 have been drawn and the date production began stands on the commission: each revision beyond the allowance is charged at 2 times USD 175.00, that is USD 350.00.
- The same commission with 2 revisions drawn and no date of production beginning: each is charged at 1 times USD 175.00, that is USD 175.00.
- The same commission with 1 revision drawn: the included revisions have not all been drawn, and nothing is charged for the revisions the change calls for.
- A Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission includes 6 revisions; with 6 drawn and the piece in production, each revision beyond the allowance is charged at 2 times USD 600.00, that is USD 1200.00.
